summary: Wrote a six-phase implementation plan making orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh's WORK (i) staging loop consult WORK (h)'s already-computed excursion verdict instead of re-reading .modified_files[] independently, ruling drop-and-warn (never refuse) because it filters stage_paths upstream and leaves git-commit-scoped.sh's exit-code contract untouched. Fail-open on absent file_scope and the specs/ carve-out are structural under this design, so they are covered by regression fixtures rather than new production code. Phase 1 establishes a red fixture (the existing excursion fixture cannot distinguish pre- from post-fix because its excursion path never exists on disk); work item 3 is planned as an explicit decline on three-source orphan evidence.

artifacts.summary: Six-phase plan: red fixture, WORK (i) filter, remaining coverage, script-header ruling, git-staging-scope.md record, final gates.
